description: Get the LIVE mid price for a ticker RIGHT NOW — use this to answer "what's X trading at?", "price of X", "how much is X", or any quote request. Crypto majors (BTC, ETH, HYPE, SOL, ...) via HyperLiquid's main perp dex, AND equities/RWA perps (Samsung 'SMSN', SK Hynix 'SKHX', 'NVDA', 'AAPL', 'TSLA', 'GOLD', ...) via HyperLiquid's builder-deployed equity dex. Returns a numeric price in USD. Null-safe: returns price=null with a note if the symbol is not found.

market.description: Optional. 'crypto' (default) = main perp dex; 'equity' = RWA/equity perp dex (Samsung, semis, etc.)

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE, or an equity like SMSN (Samsung), SKHX (SK Hynix), NVDA

name: get_price
